metadata.scenario: A long-time patient calls to book a follow-up assessment after completing their 6-week rehab program. They're excited about their progress and want to discuss next steps with the therapist. Receptionist books them for Friday at 3 PM.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Betty Lou Smith. I'm calling to book a follow-up assessment. Hi Betty! It's great to hear from you. How has your rehab program been going? It's been really good, actually! I've made a lot of progress and I'm excited to discuss the next steps. That’s wonderful to hear! I’ll make sure to schedule you with Dr. James Rodriguez for your assessment. Perfect! Can you book me for this week? Sure thing! Let me check the schedule... How about Friday at 3 PM? Yes, that works for me! Great! I’ll put you down for Friday at 3 PM with Dr. Rodriguez. Thank you! I’m really looking forward to it. You’re welcome! Is there anything specific you’d like to discuss during the assessment? I’d like to talk about my mobility and any exercises I can do at home. That sounds like a good plan. I’ll make a note for Dr. Rodriguez. Also, I was wondering if I could get some information on ongoing physical therapy sessions. Absolutely! Our physical therapy sessions are priced at $110 to $140 for 45 to 60 minutes. That sounds reasonable. I might want to schedule those as well after my assessment. Perfect! We can discuss that more on Friday after your assessment. Yes, that makes sense. Thank you for your help, Margaret. Of course, Betty! Just to confirm, you’re all set for Friday at 3 PM with Dr. Rodriguez. I appreciate it. Looking forward to it! You're very welcome! If you have any other questions in the meantime, feel free to call back. I will, thank you! Have a great day! You too, Betty! Take care, goodbye! Goodbye!
